notes: The arm of medbay_mk2, drawn pointing UP and turned about anchors.pivot (the socket ring in the middle of the 2x2 base) toward the patient; anchors.tip is the head. idle (at rest), heal (2: the lens pulses while it heals), damaged (2: forearm jammed skewed, sparks), disabled (drooped). The soft green beam and the glow on the patient are drawn in code.
